PROJ-201/361/2026-SUDA (T M P F) SECTION / 54866 1-4 dated 03-11-2026) forms part of this bid. In case of any conflict, the GeM bid document, GeM GTC a nd the SLA of this category shall prevail over the RFP. 2. Scope: Supply of qualified manpower for the State Level Technical Cell (SLTC) and City Level Technic al Cells (CLTC) for PMAY-U 2.0 in Chhattisgarh, for the designations, numbers, qualifications and experi ence given in this bid and in Section 5 of the RFP. Place of work: SUDA, Nava Raipur and ULBs of Chhatt isgarh. 3. Eligibility: (a) Registered legal entity with valid PAN, GST, EPF and ESIC registration; (b) average an nual turnover of at least ₹6.04 crore in FY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, certified by a Chartered Acc ountant (with UDIN); (c) work experience as per RFP Clause 7.3; (d) positive net worth as on 31-03-202 6 and losses in not more than two of the last five years; (e) not banned or blacklisted by any Central/St ate Government body on the bid end date, by self-declaration.

4. Additional Documents 1–4: Doc 1 – CA turnover and net-worth certificate with audited balance she ets and P&L accounts; Doc 2 – work orders with completion or performance certificates for Clause 7.3; Doc 3 – PAN, GST, EPF and ESIC registration certificates; Doc 4 – CVs of proposed staff in Form Tech-4, Methodology in Form Tech-7 and a self-declaration on blacklisting and conflict of interest. 5. Technical evaluation: As per the marking scheme in the RFP (Part II). A bidder must score at least 6 0% in each criterion and 75 marks out of 100 overall to qualify for financial opening. 6. Price: The agency/service charge (%, inclusive of GST) shall be quoted only in the GeM price form; L 1 shall be decided by GeM on total value. Nil or unrealistic charges are liable to rejection. 7. Remuneration and labour laws: Pay shown in this bid is fixed by the buyer; actual pay may be rev ised as approved by SLSMC, and the quoted agency charge shall apply on the approved pay. Salary mu st be credited to staff by the 5th of each month, with employer PF/ESIC and all labour-law compliances (including the Labour Codes, as in force) met by the service provider. 8. GST and taxes: The price shall be as calculated by GeM for this category: GeM adds GST at 18% to the buyer-fixed pay components, and the service charge % quoted by the bidder shall be inclusive of G ST. The total contract value shown on GeM is inclusive of all taxes; no GST or other tax shall be payabl e over and above it. Invoices must be GST e-invoices showing SUDA’s GSTIN and SAC 9985. TDS under Section 51 of the CGST/CGGST Act, 2017 and under the Income-tax Act shall be deducted as applicable . Any change in the GST rate after the bid end date shall be adjusted at actuals. 9. Payment: Monthly, against attendance-verified bills submitted by the 5th of the following month, wit hin the payment timeline stated in this bid. 10. Liquidated damages: 0.5% of the value of delayed or undeployed services per week or part thereof, up to a maximum of 10% of the total contract value. 11. Contract period and option: Two years. Increase or decrease in quantity or duration shall be only a s per the option clause of this GeM bid. 12. EMD: As per the EMD section of this bid and GeM GTC, including MSE/Startup exemptions. Where EM D is not paid online, the original instrument shall reach the address in the RFP within 5 days of bid open ing. 13. Queries and pre-bid meeting: Queries may be raised through the GeM Representation window or b y email to osd.suda@yahoo.com up to 05/11/2026. Pre-bid meeting: 06/11/2026 on Google Meet [http s://meet.google.com/nzp-bkzh-ptk]. Replies will be issued as a corrigendum on GeM. 14. The above-mentioned annual remunerations / emoluments and sanctioned nos. for SLTC & CLTC are purely indicative and are presented solely for tendering purposes.
